requirements.title: IBCLR argument restrictions
requirements.definition: I shall be integer and POS shall be an integer value that is nonnegative and less than BIT_SIZE(I).

pending.IBCLR-I-integer: Use an integer I with several selected bits set; mutate I to real as a source-control restriction with no diagnostic facet.
pending.IBCLR-POS-integer: Use integer POS values 0, 1, and BIT_SIZE(I)-1; mutate POS to real as a source-control restriction with no diagnostic facet.
pending.IBCLR-POS-nonnegative: Use POS=0 as the lower boundary and assert the cleared bit by BTEST; negative POS remains a source-control restriction with no diagnostic facet.
pending.IBCLR-POS-less-than-bit-size: Use POS=BIT_SIZE(I)-1 as the upper valid boundary and assert the cleared high bit by BTEST; POS=BIT_SIZE(I) remains a source-control restriction with no diagnostic facet.

requirements.oracle: Source registration only. Future fixtures use exact integer, logical, character, shape, kind, and bit-pattern observations. Bit-producing intrinsic results are observed in bit context by BTEST, POPCNT, or bit-pattern comparisons, not by signed numeric interpretation of a result whose leftmost bit may be set. Each positive plan establishes a non-default state first, uses a non-vacuous companion for zero, .FALSE., blank, or identity results, and includes a feature mutation such as changing the intrinsic name, argument order, DIM, MASK, POS, LEN, KIND, or a BOZ literal. Unnumbered argument shall-restrictions are source-control restrictions only and are not promoted to diagnostic facets.

requirements.title: IBCLR result characteristics match I
requirements.definition: The IBCLR result has the same characteristics as I.

pending.IBCLR-result-same-kind-as-I: Use I with a nondefault integer kind; assert KIND(IBCLR(I,1)) equals KIND(I) and verify the value by BTEST separately.

requirements.title: IBCLR clears exactly bit POS
requirements.definition: The IBCLR result has I's bit sequence except bit POS is zero, using the integer bit model of 16.3.

pending.IBCLR-clears-selected-bit: Use I with bits 0, 1, 3, and BIT_SIZE(I)-1 set; call IBCLR(I,1) and assert BTEST(result,1) is false, with POS mutation to 3.
pending.IBCLR-preserves-other-observed-bits: For the same call assert by BTEST that bits 0, 3, and BIT_SIZE(I)-1 remain true and an originally clear bit remains false.
